title: Julesburg, Colorado Territory, May 1866
summary: Julesburg is a stage station on the South Platte, burned last year and rebuilt in sod, with Fort Sedgwick's soldiers up the road and the telegraph humming overhead. Be one of its people, or make your own.

playerSlot.summary: You make your own person at Julesburg, the Overland's stage station on the South Platte.

roles.label: Saloon keeper
roles.desc: Pours the whiskey and hears everything.

roles.label: Storekeeper
roles.desc: Sells everything on credit to people they trust.

roles.label: Deputy
roles.desc: Keeps order for the marshal or the town, for a wage.

roles.label: Drover
roles.desc: Rides herd, and waits in town for wages that don't come.

roles.label: Blacksmith
roles.desc: Shoes horses and mends wagons, and knows everyone's business.

clocks.name: The westbound coach is overdue
clocks.fireText: The westbound coach comes in at last, its horses blown, an arrow in its door panel and one passenger missing.

opening:
Evening on the Overland road. The sun goes down red over the South Platte, and the westbound coach that should have come in at four still hasn't. Abner Moss has been out on the road three times to look.

In the telegraph office the sounder is clattering: Nell Haskins writes fast, then stops, then tears the sheet off and folds it before anyone can read it over her shoulder.

Up the road at Fort Sedgwick a bugle calls, thin in the wind. Jacques Rouleau, in the door of his store with his pipe, says to no one, "Eh. They are always late, the coaches. Until the day they are not coming at all."
